author: reek
body: The same acquisition over the Intel card rather than the NE2000, which is the card the demo runs on. The two arms differ only in their `.vmargs`, so a difference in the rows is a difference in the card and nothing else.

author: reek
body: The card row is what makes this arm distinguishable from its sibling: if `net-driver-bring-up` failed to bind, the seam falls back to the NE2000 and prints so, and with `-e1000-nat` set that fallback has no wire at all -- the NAT is on the Intel part. So a run that says ne2000 here has not tested what this file is named for.
